تستهووا (form X)
# تَسْتَهْوُوا (tastahwū) /tas.tah.wuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْوَى (istahwā)
# تُسْتَهْوَوْا (tustahwaw) /tus.tah.waw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْوَى (istahwā)
